Quick answers and next steps:
- Pen test report: I can share a redacted executive summary immediately and request the full report exchange under an NDA if you need it. I've attached the executive summary (Redwood_PenTest_Report_03192026.pdf).
- Vulnerability management: attaching our SLA and a short write-up on cadence and disclosure (Vuln_Management_SLA_2026.xlsx). In brief: automated external scans weekly, internal scans nightly for critical infra, triage window of 48 hours for P0/P1, patching SLAs vary by severity (P0: 7 days, P1: 30 days), coordinated disclosure and customer notification for any user-impacting issue.
- SOC 2 / compliance: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (Security) in 2025; we also have documented controls for GDPR data subject requests. For HIPAA, we support Covered Entity workflows in Private deployments - we can provide a summary of controls and a BA agreement template if required.

Next steps I propose:

Thanks Marissa - looping in a bit more detail from Security.

Sean / Alyssa,
A few clarifications on the items Marissa shared:
- Pen test: The public-facing executive summary (attached) includes scope and high-level findings. For the full report, we require an NDA and an access request from your security team. Typical turnaround after NDA is 48 hours.
- Scan cadence: External authenticated scans weekly; periodic full external/infrastructure scans monthly; internal agent-based scanning on critical hosts nightly. We also run CI/CD pipeline SCA tooling on PRs.
- Triage & SLAs: We classify severities as P0/P1/P2/P3. For customer-impacting P0 we aim for mitigation or documented workaround within 7 days; P1 within 30 days. For infrastructure-only P0s we prioritize hotfixes. We provide a shared vulnerability tracker (CSV or JIRA) and weekly remediation sync on higher-severity findings.
- Disclosure: If a vulnerability affects customer data or functionality, we notify affected customers within 72 hours of confirming impact and publish a post-incident bulletin depending on severity. For non-customer-impacting findings we follow internal timed disclosure and remediation.
- HIPAA/GDPR: We maintain documented controls; HIPAA support is available but depends on deployment model (Private recommended).

Attachments: Redwood_PenTest_Report_03192026.pdf, Vuln_Management_SLA_2026.xlsx

If you want, we can schedule a 30-min call with our security engineering lead to walk through the SLA and sample remediation tickets.

- Rishi
